title: incident-bot: SLO toolkit on-call diagnostics helpers and runbook linking improvements
author: Priya Nair
body: Motivation: Improve on-call context and automated diagnostics surfaced by incident-bot when SLO alerts trigger. This change adds a set of helpers in the SLO toolkit to produce compact diagnostics summaries, improves runbook linking heuristics, and wires additional telemetry to help prioritize runbooks during noisy incidents. The goal is to reduce mean time to resolution for SREs and on-call engineers by surfacing higher-quality, actionable runbooks and correlated SLO context. What changed: 1) New SLO toolkit helpers: slo_toolkit/oncall/helpers.py adds utilities to compute prioritized runbook lists, compact diagnostic summaries, and a small ranking model that weights precedent, last-run success, and relevance scores. 2) Runbook linking improvements: incident-bot/service/runbook_linker.py now uses expanded heuristics (title+aliases+tag matching, SLO tag overlap, recent usage signals) and adds a fallback prefix match with confidence scoring. 3) Telemetry: added metrics incident_bot.runbook_candidate_count, incident_bot.runbook_score_histogram, slo_toolkit.oncall.compact_summary_latency and traced end-to-end in the bot flow. 4) Tests and e2e: unit tests for helpers and runbook linker; lightweight e2e harness simulating SLO alert -> candidate selection. 5) Docs: updated oncall/README.md with examples and migration notes. Migration notes: The new ranking stores a small metadata blob on candidate entries; when upgrading, the system will backfill no more than 1k records per minute. There's a feature flag incident_bot.runbook_linker_v2 to toggle behavior during rollout. Checklist: - [x] Add helpers and ranking code - [x] Add unit tests and e2e harness - [x] Add CI checks and flaky-test mitigation - [x] Add docs and migration notes - [x] Add telemetry and tracing - [x] Get reviews and signoff by SREs Related: ENG-4312 (prioritization work), PM-102 (on-call UX), SUP-2101 (customer escalations referencing runbook relevance).
commits_summary: a1b2c3: add initial helpers and tests; d4e5f6: runbook linker heuristics and fallback; 7a8b9c: telemetry + metrics + tracing; c0ffee: docs and migration notes; deadbeef: test fixes and flaky mitigation
review_comments: Ethan Cole: The ranking weights look reasonable but we should expose a knob in the config rather than hardcode the constants. Author reply: added config knobs incident_bot.ranking.weights and documented defaults.
Samir Patel: e2e harness looks flaky in CI due to timing; can we make waits deterministic? Author reply: switched to deterministic fake clock in tests, added retries and reduced flakiness.
Lina Zhou: telemetry naming collisions with existing metrics? Author reply: renamed metric to incident_bot.runbook_score_histogram and added a mapping in metrics registry.
Ethan Cole: Please add a short migration plan for existing runbook metadata. Author reply: added scripts/backfill_runbook_metadata.py and migration notes in docs/runbook-migration.md.
Samir Patel: Approved after tiny nits fixed.
ci_checks: CI / integration: pass (e2e rerun after fix)
merge_summary: Merged by Priya Nair using squash merge on 2025-02-03. Commit message consolidated the feature and test fixes. Post-merge: feature flag incident_bot.runbook_linker_v2 enabled for 10% rollout and monitoring dashboards added.
release_notes: Improved runbook linking and on-call diagnostics: adds SLO toolkit helpers for prioritized runbooks and compact diagnostics, improved linking heuristics, telemetry, and migration tooling. Feature flagged rollout.
